evidence_basis: Review (secondary). Paragraphs on Triac, Triac Trial II and transporter route were read; other sections were not.

Locator L1 (Section on TRIAC; for: Trial II design (as described by the review); result not available in this source): "A second international phase IIb trial (TRIAC Trial II; NCT02396459) is currently being conducted to assess the neurocognitive outcome in MCT8 patients who are younger than 30 months at baseline and receive TRIAC for 96 months at a higher dose compared to TRIAC Trial I."

Locator L2 (Section on TRIAC; for: Candidate murine Triac transporter route, age-dependent (review statement)): "Particularly, the Slc22a8 transporter present at the murine BBB and BCSFB is strongly expressed only during the early postnatal phase"

Locator L3 (Conclusions; for: No neurological benefit shown by any intervention at the review date): "Unfortunately, none of these interventions has so far resulted in profound beneficial effects on the neurological outcome."
